name: cachet
description: BCH × Nostr identity: bind a Bitcoin Cash address to a Nostr key, discover it on relays, verify it anywhere.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,rp-a,rp-b -c gray,green,blue "npm run dev -w @cachet/web" "npm run dev:a -w @cachet/rp" "npm run dev:b -w @cachet/rp"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @cachet/web && npm run build -w @cachet/rp
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -k -n relay,web,rp-a,rp-b -c magenta,gray,green,blue "npm run dev:relay" "VITE_RELAYS=ws://127.0.0.1:7777 npm run dev -w @cachet/web" "RELAYS=ws://127.0.0.1:7777 npm run dev:a -w @cachet/rp" "RELAYS=ws://127.0.0.1:7777 npm run dev:b -w @cachet/rp"
scripts.dev:web-local: concurrently -k -n relay,web -c magenta,gray "npm run dev:relay" "VITE_RELAYS=ws://127.0.0.1:7777 npm run dev -w @cachet/web"
